::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Convert sf to Spatial
hunan_sp <- as(hunan, "Spatial")

# Then run gwss on hunan_sp
gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
               vars = "GDPPC",
               bw = bw_AIC,
               kernel = "bisquare",
               adaptive = FALSE,
               longlat = T)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Convert gwss SDF output into a data frame
gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Append the newly derived data.frame onto hunan_sf
hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan, gwstat_df)
```
:::


### Plotting and Visualisation

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Plot geographically weighted mean
tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_fill("GDPPC_LM",           
          style = "quantile",
          palette = "Blues",
          title = "GW Mean of GDPPC") +
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5)
```
